# AGM Rent a Car

Follow the canonical repository rules in `/AGENTS.md` and the operating process
in `/docs/MANUAL_OPERATIVO.md`. Treat `code.html`, `assets/`, `supabase/`, and
`scripts/` as source; never edit or commit `dist/`. Never expose secrets or a
Supabase service-role key. Keep RLS, strict CORS, server-side validation and the
email-first operating model intact. Run `npm ci` and `npm run verify` before
proposing completion.
